subject: The fontface and family adjustment does not work

messages.author: 79b25fdcdc04d365
messages.subject: The fontface and family adjustment does not work
parts:
I am just trying with the 'geom_text' example in the following page:

http://wiki.stdout.org/rcookbook/Graphs/Fonts/

It does not work for me. Nothing is changed for the text plotted using
geom_text().

The same for the "Table of fonts" example.

But it does work with the 'theme_text' function...

What could be the possible reason for this ?

Thx
FU

messages.author: 79b25fdcdc04d365
messages.subject: Re: The fontface and family adjustment does not work
parts:
Problem solved.
Somehow I had version 0.8.9 installed instead of the should be version
0.9.0.
Upgrade solved the issue.

FU
